title: Transcriptomic and Epigenomic profiles analysis during human adaptation to simulated High-Altitude Hypoxia
description: Hypobaric hypoxia (HH) is characterized by reduced oxygen availability resulting from the decreased barometric pressure at high altitudes. This condition imposes substantial physiological challenges not only on populations permanently residing in high-altitude regions but also on individuals who intermittently ascend to such environments for occupational, recreational, or other purposes. Overall design: RNA-Seq and microRNA-seq from PBMCs of subjects exposed to acute hyperbaric hypoxia by terraXcube facility
